agent-manifest.description: Deterministic eligibility service: given a patient's plan and a requested service, returns eligible / not-eligible with a reason and an estimated self-pay cost. Point-in-time only; it does not book anything.

offer.body: A coverage verdict {eligible, reason, estimatedSelfPay} for a service under the patient's plan.
The verdict is point-in-time and is not a guarantee of payment; the booking agent must have the patient acknowledge a not-covered result before proceeding self-pay.

use.body: Reads the verified patient's plan id to evaluate coverage.
